question: When does Sikkim celebrate its statehood?
solution:
The correct answer is __16th May. ____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Sikkim celebrates its statehood day on 16 May__ every year.
 
• It marks the day in 1975 when Sikkim transitioned to become the 22nd state of India from being a monarchy earlier.
 
• The Indo-Sikkimese treaty was signed in the year 1950.
 
• With this, Sikkim became a protectorate of India.
 
• Before this, the Namgyal dynasty ruled Sikkim till 1975.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Sikkim: 

 
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 1.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 1.
 
• State Animal - Red panda.
 
• State Bird - Green imperial pigeon.
 
• National Park - Khangchendzonga National Park.
